patthana24.15:1.1: Nasaraṇaṃ nasahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naaraṇaṃ nasahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
